articles.title: Barry Lopez on the Cure for Our Existential Loneliness and the Three Tenets of a Full Life
articles.highlight: 现代文明的两大标志——存在的孤独与生命无足轻重感，部分源于我们放弃了与地方关系的疗愈性信念。
articles.summary: 文章引用巴里·洛佩兹的观点，指出现代人的存在性孤独和生命无意义感，部分来自放弃对‘地方’关系疗愈力量的信念。重拾与具体地方的有意义联结，能缓解这种孤独并赋予生命分量。文章从生活技能角度提醒读者，在抽象化、流动化的现代生活中，别忽略所在地的滋养。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键启示：孤独并非只能靠人际联结解决，人与‘地方’的深层关系同样具有疗愈作用；日常中留意、照顾自己所在的具体环境，是低成本且有实证感的生命锚点。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "Existential loneliness and a sense that one’s life is inconsequential, both of which are hallmarks of modern civilizations, seem to me to derive in part from our abandoning a belief in the therapeutic dimensions of a relationship with place."

articles.title: Frankenstein Author Mary Shelley on the Surest Remedy for a Sunken Spirit and What Makes Life Worth Living
articles.highlight: 生命之复杂谜题仅有一个解法：提升我们自己，并为他人的幸福作贡献。
articles.summary: 本文摘自玛丽·雪莱的《最后一个人》，以一句凝练的话回应“生活究竟为了什么”：自我改进与让他人幸福。文章把它作为面对情绪低落和存在困惑时的可靠药方，提醒读者意义来自具体的善意行动而非空想。值得花两分钟读一读，给疲惫生活一个清晰的方向。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键收获：陷入消沉或迷茫时，最有用的做法不是反复追问意义，而是先去做一点自我提升的事，并带给身边人一些实在的好处，这能自然恢复内心的秩序。
articles.sourceExcerpt: "There is but one solution to the intricate riddle of life; to improve ourselves, and contribute to the happiness of others."

en.highlight: See how ONE system prompt turns Opus 5 from a 'load-bearing' smartass into a precise, cracked senior engineering partner.
en.summary: This repository shows how a single well-crafted system prompt can drastically reshape Opus 5's output quality, turning it from a vague, overconfident assistant into a focused and precise engineering collaborator. It is a concrete case study for anyone interested in prompt engineering and turning LLM behavior into real product value.
en.failureAnalysis: The approach is highly dependent on a specific model version and prompt wording, and can break after model updates; there is also no rigorous evaluation, so 'precision' may be anecdotal. Adoption is further limited by cost and reproducibility, making it hard for enterprises to rely on one prompt for stable engineering-grade output.
